positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Manhattan Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: "I worked in a Special Access Program”

positions.title: Founder & Executive Director
positions.locationName: Greater Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Building AI powered software for the public sector.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Applications)
positions.description:
* Integrated computer vision capabilities onto Puma sUAS and SwitchBlade loitering munition system, enabling person & vehicle object detection, as part of a $26.1 million contract with the US Special Operations Command. Software is deployed on 700 units sent to aid Ukraine as part of President Biden’s $800M security package.
* Application Software Engineer in Aerovironment's Learning and Active Perception (LEAP) team where I work on object detection (person, car, ship, pose estimation) at the Edge with a NVIDIA Jetson.
* Maintain internal libraries that handle streams of video encoding and decoding, and tracking metadata.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
* Led development of mission-critical module on MQ-1C Unmanned Aerial System; written in C++.  Wrote 80% of the code and reviewed the other 20%. Demonstration to DoD customer secured a $25 million contract.
* Identified unavailability of embedded hardware as an operational problem, and got management buy-in to pursue architecture compatible with testing \& development on Linux developer environment during COVID-19 lockdown. Pioneered department-wide initiative of 20+ engineers to adopt test driven development.
* Led a team of 7 developers to adopt CppUTest unit testing framework on flight critical software. Expanded code coverage to 55%.  Increase in maintainability reduced software development time &
budget by 75% by detecting memory leaks, preventing regressions, and describing specification & behavior via tests.
* Modernized and decomposed monolithic legacy C89 embedded flight critical software into 62,000 lines (1/3rd of code base) of modern C++14. Implemented risk mitigation strategy that achieved successful first flight.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
* Primary developer (wrote 100% of code) of ethernet functionality on avionics bare metal system by using LwIP TCP/IP library in C. Moving away from RS-232 serial increased scalability by enabling transfer speeds of 100 Mbps versus 230,400 baud (over 400x increase), leading to 10x increase in internal messaging.
*Established Jenkins continuous integration server, populated with 25+ build jobs that verifies builds nightly and after every commit. This enabled continuous delivery of demonstrable features for stakeholders.
* Determined requirements and implemented engine code in C to increase reliability by handling faults.
* Observed difficulty of searching internal data. Designed and implemented a discussion forum for the secure network using Linux, Apache, PostgreSQL, Python 3.9, and Django. Forum services 60 engineers.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
• Managed 113 Lab Computers and Cal Poly servers with Information Technology Consultant.
• Assist Professors in teaching Computer Science courses, CS 140: Intro to Prog, Problem-Solving and CS 130: Discrete Structures, and CS 599: Machine Learning.

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description:
• Visualized University data for Office of Student Success. Utilizing R and exploratory statistical analysis techniques to determine what qualities of students influence the 4 year graduation rate.
• Provided support for 20 Computer Science, 8 Math, 3 Physics, and 1 Engineering course(s).
• ”Orientation Leader” - Represented the CS department in assisting the transition of new and transfer students to CPP.

positions.title: App Development Teacher
positions.description:
• Taught a week-long introductory course on Android App development to Middle and High Schoolers.
• Created a text messaging app with the use of Firebase and SQL.
• Organized a team of 7 mentors to teach 34 students.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted Lawyers by providing Litigants self-help in Unlawful Detainer and Divorce cases.
• Used Excel to keep track of walk-ins and used basic statistics to discover what days more volunteers are needed.

company.name: Neighborhood Legal Services of Los Angeles

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Google IgniteCS at Cal Poly Pomona
volunteerExperiences.description:
• Founded and charted a club on campus that provides CS education for K-12 students to help increase multicultural diversity in the tech field. Taught at 13 different schools so far. We focus on mid-low income communities that do not give their kids opportunities to pursue Computer Science. Resulted in kids founding their own CS clubs in their schools.
• Managed a budget of $7,000. Organized a team of 20 students to develop and maintain a portal where mentors can teach K-12 students a technical curriculum on Scratch, App Development, Java, Python, and HTML/CSS. Used Git/GitHub. 
• Fostered college students to grow public speaking skills in a team building environment to pursue traditional and non-traditional forms of teaching in Computer Science and Mathematics topics.
• See what we are about here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GlkuWM1v4F0

company.name: Google IgniteCS at Cal Poly Pomona
